The '''Ushmin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ushmin]].
